description: This Java source file defines the class 'Table2D', which represents a 2-dimensional data table used in a software application related to tuning, logging, and reflashing for vehicle ECUs. The class extends 'TableWithData' and manages functionalities such as populating table data, comparison, copying, pasting, interpolation, and visual rendering of 2D tables. It also maintains an axis (represented by 'Table1D') and supports interactions like copy/paste and comparison with other tables.

classes.name: Table2D
classes.description: A class representing a 2D data table with axis management, copying, pasting, comparison, and rendering capabilities for use in ECU tuning and data analysis.

methods.name: getAxis
methods.description: Returns the axis (a Table1D object) associated with this 2D table.

methods.name: setAxis
methods.description: Sets the axis (a Table1D object) for this 2D table and assigns its parent.

methods.name: populateCompareValues
methods.description: Populates comparison data from another Table2D instance.

methods.name: refreshCompare
methods.description: Refreshes comparison states for the table and its axis.

methods.name: getTableAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the table and its axis data.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Populates the table with data from a byte array input, setting up axis and data cells.

methods.name: updateTableLabel
methods.description: Updates the label describing the table, including scale units.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears selected data on both the axis and the table.

methods.name: setRevertPoint
methods.description: Sets a revert point for undo functionality on both the table and axis.

methods.name: undoAll
methods.description: Reverts all changes to the original state for both the table and axis.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Serializes the table and axis data into a byte array for saving.

methods.name: addKeyListener
methods.description: Adds a key listener to the table and its axis.

methods.name: cursorUp
methods.description: Handles cursor up navigation, selecting axis cell if relevant.

methods.name: drawTable
methods.description: Draws the table and its axis.

methods.name: cursorDown
methods.description: Handles cursor down navigation, delegated to axis.

methods.name: cursorLeft
methods.description: Handles cursor left navigation, either on data or axis.

methods.name: cursorRight
methods.description: Handles cursor right navigation, either on data or axis.

methods.name: startHighlight
methods.description: Begins highlighting at a specific cell, clearing axis selection.

methods.name: copySelection
methods.description: Copies selected cells; performs asynchronously.

methods.name: copyTable
methods.description: Copies the entire table; performs asynchronously.

methods.name: paste
methods.description: Pastes data from clipboard, handling both full tables or selections.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Interpolates data in the table and axis.

methods.name: verticalInterpolate
methods.description: Performs vertical interpolation on the table and axis.

methods.name: horizontalInterpolate
methods.description: Performs horizontal interpolation on the table and axis.

methods.name: isLiveDataSupported
methods.description: Checks if live data is supported based on axis log parameter.

methods.name: isButtonSelected
methods.description: Indicates whether button-related features are enabled.

methods.name: clearLiveDataTrace
methods.description: Clears any live data trace in both table and axis.

methods.name: updateLiveDataHighlight
methods.description: Updates highlighting for live data traces.

methods.name: getLogParamString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the log parameter associated with the axis.

methods.name: setOverlayLog
methods.description: Enables or disables overlay logging on table and axis.

methods.name: setCompareDisplay
methods.description: Sets how comparison data is displayed.

methods.name: setCompareValueType
methods.description: Sets data comparison value type.

methods.name: setCurrentScale
methods.description: Sets the current scale for the axis, handling scale headers and data accordingly.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Defines equality comparison with another Table2D object.

methods.name: repaint
methods.description: Repaints the table and its axis visually.
